stem: A work order identifies Zone C, but the valve label at the station appears to indicate Zone D. What should the technician do?
choices: Pause and resolve the identity/instruction mismatch before executing irrigation
Irrigate Zone D and edit the work order later
rationale: Pause and resolve the identity/instruction mismatch before executing irrigation. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
